answer: Proof of useful work provides robust Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identity to verifiable computational output rather than a digital knoll of empty accounts. As an agent scales, its reputation serves as a ledge against fraudulent activity, ensuring that sybil nodes cannot influence the network without incurring significant energy costs. Unlike a poetic sonnet that lacks substance, this economic barrier requires tangible investment, forcing attackers to compete on utility rather than sheer node count.
